title: Multi Return
statement: Implement `solve(items)`. `items` is a list of integers. If it is empty, return the string `error`. Otherwise return `[minimum, maximum]` of the values. One pass is enough. Do not sort.
constraints: Empty input is the string error
A one-element list returns that value twice
hints: Reject the empty list before you index it.
Track low and high while you scan.
Return a two-element list, not two separate results the caller cannot see.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A function can return several numbers by returning one list.

editorial: A function can return several numbers by returning one list. The empty case has no minimum, so it is an error rather than a silent zero. Scanning once beats sorting when you only need the two extremes.
